description: This stacked bar chart compares two methods, labeled "Ours" and "Standard," based on the distribution of three categories: "Context," "Generated Response," and "Other," as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis displays the two methods, "Ours" positioned above "Standard," while the vertical axis represents the percentage composition of each category within the respective method. The chart uses a stacked bar format where each bar is divided into three colored segments corresponding to the categories: blue for "Context," orange for "Generated Response," and green for "Other." For the "Ours" method, the blue segment ("Context") occupies 60.6% of the bar, the orange segment ("Generated Response") occupies 31.7%, and the green segment ("Other") occupies 7.7%. For the "Standard" method, the blue segment ("Context") occupies 23.6%, the orange segment ("Generated Response") occupies 51.1%, and the green segment ("Other") occupies 25.3%. The bars are presented in descending order of total height, with "Ours" being taller than "Standard," and there are no visual emphasis or annotations beyond the percentage labels within each segment.
